name: Curly hair care and styling routines
what_it_is: Videos show people with curly and wavy hair demonstrating care and styling routines: before-and-after transformations, wash-and-style stages (dirty, wet, brushed out, styled), defining curls with finger coiling or spiral rods, and shine/gloss treatments. Several are sponsored posts for curl products (Garnier Nutrisse Glossy Curls, L'Oréal Elvive Glycolic Gloss, Twisty curl cream), and captions frame frizz as misunderstood curls rather than damage.
